description: Canonical ingredient dictionary. One entry per real ingredient; `id` is the stable key stored on recipe rows (`ingredient`). Names are the standard shopping-list wording per language.
correction_note: 233rd entry asparagus-beans-frozen added after verification: asparagus beans (yardlong beans) are not edamame/soy, so they must not be merged (it would add a soy flag to fr-77).
